reply.text: {"say":"Here is Arnold's chest and back day exactly as you listed it: bench, incline bench, pullovers, chin-ups, bent-over rows, then deadlifts to finish.","title":"Arnold's Chest & Back","days":[{"name":"Chest & Back","exercises":[{"key":"barbell-bench-press","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Touch mid-chest, drive feet into the floor"},{"key":"barbell-incline-bench-press","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"30-degree incline, bar to upper chest"},{"key":"dumbbell-pullover","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Slight elbow bend, deep stretch behind head"},{"key":"chin-up","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Full hang at the bottom, chest to bar"},{"key":"barbell-bent-over-row","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Flat back, pull to lower ribs"},{"key":"barbell-deadlift","sets":3,"reps":6,"repsTo":8,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Bar close to shins, brace before each pull"}]}],"unmet":[]}
